scope: Atomic mounting, alignment, connection and individual testing of two explicitly selected pump-motor units on baseframes, Q=45 m3/h and H=55 m. Station collectors, water reservoir, automation and the complete pumping station are excluded.
sourceAuthority: Approved plumbing project organization, selected pump manufacturer and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved pump schedule and exact selected pump-motor-baseframe passport
foundation and baseframe drawing with anchor and shim schedules
grout placement card and approved non-shrink grout quantity
piping connection schedule with flange kits and conditional flexible connectors
method statement with installation/alignment labor, lifting and torque-tool quantities
alignment and individual test program with laser tool, vibration analyzer and labor quantities
supplier pack size and approved retained-spare quantity
forbiddenClaims: automatic pump selection or hydraulic design
universal anchor, shim, grout, flange, isolator or connector consumption
universal labor, lifting, alignment, test or logistics productivity
station collectors, water reservoir, automation or complete pumping station included
